comparison: Same-job original baseline; postselected winners additionally need same-layout baseline.
selection: Exploratory screen, freeze candidate before independent confirmation, preserve all failures.
scope: Best among tested layouts and circuits, not a global optimum proof.
selection_detail: Compare all candidates; a postselected winner must beat the same-layout unprotected control as well as the original baseline in two fresh jobs. If postselection has no supported benefit, prefer all-shot baseline with strong fidelity and no discarded data. Screening rankings alone are exploratory.
